row.evidence: Vidyard's SSO article says it supports Just In Time (JIT) provisioning through SAML and that "De-provisioning users is currently not supported"; no SCIM endpoint is documented.
row.notes: No SCIM. SAML SSO (Enterprise only, Contact Sales) creates and updates users by JIT on first IdP-initiated sign-in and maps them to teams with a vyTeam SAML attribute; de-provisioning is not supported. The Dashboard API (Enterprise only on the pricing comparison and help article) can list, get and update users and list teams and roles, but documents no create or delete. Starter $59/seat/mo billed annually; Teams and Enterprise are custom-priced. Okta's OIN app is SWA only; Entra's gallery app is SSO with JIT.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: API availability on Enterprise is inferred from the help article's plan badge and the API row being 'Not Included' on the other three plans.

limitations.text: No SCIM endpoint is documented; the SSO article's capability table lists only SAML JIT provisioning and says de-provisioning is not supported.

scim.notes: available is false because Vidyard's SSO capability table describes provisioning as JIT only; Vidyard never names SCIM.

auth.notes: Folder-scoped, role-based API tokens passed as the auth_token parameter.

citations.title: Manage user access to Vidyard with SAML Single Sign On (SSO)

citations.title: Manage user access to Vidyard with SAML Single Sign On (SSO)
citations.quote: Create a custom attribute in your IdP with the name vyTeam. The corresponding value should be the name of the team in Vidyard that you want to assign users to.
